predecessors.name: Ilkhanate
predecessors.text: Iraq with Baghdad, Khuzestan and Diyar Bakr: 'Despite all loss Hasan Buzurg retained control of Diyar Bakr, Iraq, Khuzestan and Baghdad' after the 1338 peace

successors.name: Qara Qoyunlu
successors.text: lower Iraq: Hillah, Wasit and Basra

successors.name: Timurid Empire
successors.text: Azerbaijan and Soltaniyeh taken by Timur in 1384-1386, Baghdad in 1393 and 1401

ledger.x: 1340: Shaykh Hasan-i Buzurg founds the Jalayirid state at Baghdad after the Ilkhanate's breakup.
1357: the Jalayirids occupy Tiflis.
1358: Tiflis is left (the occupation lasted 1357-1358).
1358: the seat moves to Tabriz (infobox 'Tabriz (1358-1388)'; the page's text has Uways take Tabriz in 1360).
August 1358: Uways conquers Azerbaijan from the Golden Horde.
1359: the Muzaffarid Shah Shuja takes Tabriz.
1360: Uways retakes Azerbaijan.
1364: Uways campaigns against Shirvan.
1374: Uways dies at Tabriz (10 October 1374).
1384: Timur takes Soltaniyeh.
1386: Timur takes Tabriz and Azerbaijan.
1388: the seat returns to Baghdad (infobox 'Baghdad (1388-1411)'; the text has Ahmad based in Baghdad from 1386).
1393: Timur captures Baghdad and Ahmad flees to the Mamluks.
1394: Ahmad retakes Baghdad.
1401: Timur takes Baghdad after a forty-day siege.
1405: Ahmad recovers Baghdad after Timur's death.
1406: Tabriz passes to Ahmad.
1409: the seat moves to Hillah (infobox 'Hillah (1409-1410)').
1410: Qara Yusuf kills Ahmad and takes Tabriz.
1410: Baghdad is lost and the dynasty is 'pushed into lower Iraq (Hillah, Wasit, Basra)'.
1411: the seat moves to Basra (infobox 'Basra (1411-1432)').
1423: Sultan Muhammad is expelled from Shushtar by the Timurids.
October 1431: the Qara Qoyunlu take Hillah.
1432: the Qara Qoyunlu end the Jalayirids.

wars.name: Chobanid attack on Baghdad (1347)
wars.outcome: The Chobanid army sent by Malik Ashraf failed to take Baghdad: 'Jalayirid forces, however, inflicted heavy losses on the force, which was forced to retreat by the summer.'

wars.name: Golden Horde conquest of Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: Jani Beg's Golden Horde overran the Chobanids in 1357 (Tabriz taken, Malik Ashraf executed); Uways conquered Azerbaijan in August 1358.

wars.name: Muzaffarid occupation of Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: Shah Shuja held Azerbaijan, Arran and briefly Tabriz for four months in 1359; Uways reconquered it in 1360.

wars.name: Jalayirid campaigns against Shirvan and the Qara Qoyunlu
wars.outcome: The Shirvanshah Kavus became a Jalayirid vassal after Bayram Beg besieged Shamakhi; in 1366 Uways defeated Birdi Khwaja of the Black Sheep Turkmen.

wars.name: Timur's wars against the Jalayirids
wars.outcome: Timur took Soltaniyeh (1384), Tabriz (1386), Baghdad (1393, lost again 1394) and Baghdad again in 1401; Ahmad took refuge with the Mamluks.

wars.name: Siege of Baghdad (1401)
wars.outcome: Timur besieged Baghdad for forty days; Ahmad fled; Baghdad stayed under Timurid occupation until 1405.

wars.name: Qara Qoyunlu conquest of the Jalayirid lands
wars.outcome: Qara Yusuf retook Tabriz in 1406 jointly with Ahmad, killed him in 1410 and pushed the dynasty into lower Iraq; Hillah fell in October 1431 and the Jalayirids ended in 1432.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is given by any page opened; Iraq's river frontiers and the Azerbaijan and Zagros marches are approximate, and the dynasty's holdings change by raid, siege and succession.
